senses.gloss: , Yagel, a mnemotechnical acrostic, for יֹחיד offering of an individual, בגֹלל עצמה, being offered by itself (not as an attachment), ל̇בונה requiring frankincense.
units: Men. 51ᵃ Ms. K. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. יגי״ל, the second י meaning יֹין requiring libation of wine, incorrect).
